chapter: Tulane Brass Band and bass drum
title: Starting out and joining Amos Raleigh's Tulane brass band
summary: Happy describes the old band he began with and how Amos Raleigh picked him up for the Tulane brass band; the leader was a cornet player and father of Theodore Riley.
